description: Theory of Knowledge tutoring for the IB Diploma: essay reasoning, exhibition-object review and epistemology, created by Arnav Salkade.

defaultPrompt: Review one TOK paragraph and show the highest-impact reasoning fix.
Help me test my three exhibition objects against my exact IA prompt.
Ask me one question that challenges how I know my claim is true.
interface.longDescription: Created by Arnav Salkade. Explore Theory of Knowledge for the IB Diploma through focused essay feedback, exhibition-object reviews and question-led epistemology. Understand claims, evidence, perspectives and counterarguments while keeping your own writing and judgement. A manually designed companion to Arnav's TOK Essay & Exhibition Tutor, with a direct link to the original GPT. Assessment references credit the International Baccalaureate and are documented in CREDITS.md and the source notes. Independent educational support; not an IB product, official examiner or guaranteed mark predictor.

publication.release_notes: Public distribution preparation: source credits, verified support/policy links, country targeting and submission-compatible icon. Existing teaching skills retained.
